text: The Patriots face Jacksonville this Sunday with their roster in flux and their clock management under scrutiny: Mike Onwenu's broken right ankle leaves a significant hole at right guard, safety Dell Pettus has been placed on injured reserve, and the team has promoted linebacker Jose Ramirez from the practice squad while adding linebacker Benton Whitley to the practice squad in response. On the injury front, rookie tight end Eli Raridon's return to practice offers a modest silver lining as the team monitors his status ahead of the Week 3 matchup at Everbank Stadium. Beyond the personnel moves, the beat writers are zeroing in on a tactical problem that's becoming impossible to ignore: after two consecutive games of questionable decision-making late in the second quarter, the Patriots have acknowledged they must significantly improve their clock management before halftime, a discipline issue that could prove costly against a Jacksonville squad they'll face at 1 PM ET on Sunday.
